description: Start a background job that re-records one step of a flow with the agent (optionally with a new instruction), then verifies it over several runs and re-pins it. Needs a model API key. Credentials: write each secret as one {{env:NAME}} marker ({{totp:NAME}} for a one-time code), exactly as written: the marker alone, never the value and never $NAME. NAME must be set in the environment the MCP server was started with. Never ask the user for a secret value. Returns a job_id: poll job_status.

cwd.description: Project directory (absolute) the command runs in; sitelooper.config.json is found from here. Default: the server's working directory.

instruction.description: Replacement instruction for the step (sent on stdin). Omit to keep the recorded one.

vars.description: Flow variables, passed as repeated --var k=v. "{n}" in a value is replaced per run with a fresh value. Never a secret: use {{env:NAME}} markers in instructions instead.

name: rerecord
